issue: Visitors with more than one "first" traffic source
handling: A first-touch source should never change; channel results use each visitor’s first event and are read as rough.

issue: Visits where shipping info is logged before checkout starts
handling: The two fire together, so they are treated as one step.

issue: Visits with a purchase but no add-to-cart in that visit
handling: Buyers often add to cart in an earlier visit, so funnels follow visitors, not single visits.

issue: Purchase events without an order ID
handling: Left out of order counts and revenue; still counted as buyers.

issue: Purchase events that repeat an order already counted
Days with no add-to-cart events at all
handling: Cart tracking was off until 16 Nov 2020 and on and off until 25 Nov; cart analysis starts 25 Nov.

issue: Purchased product IDs that also appear on a product view
handling: IDs were obfuscated per event type, so products cannot be followed from view to sale; product analysis uses purchases only.
